This checkpoint restores Yellow's Route 2 aide reward: record at least ten caught species, then speak to Oak's aide in the southeastern gatehouse to receive Flash. It uses HeartGold's reusable TM70 Flash and normal teaching/field systems. All prototype 0035 changes are included.

Please test: the aide's refusal below ten caught species, reward at ten, repeat dialogue, teaching Flash, normal Save/Continue and using Flash in Rock Tunnel. The requirement counts caught species, not merely seen entries. Make room in the TM pocket if necessary. Back up your save.

Verified: four focused checks cover caught thresholds, full-pocket retry, one-time reward and preservation. Native tests confirmed refusal on a four-owned copied save; a clearly labeled Dex-only ten-owned fixture received the reward. Normal teaching to the existing Umbreon, reusable TM quantity, saving and fresh Continue with repeat-only dialogue passed. Native Flash use expanded Rock Tunnel's visibility.

Limits: the eligibility test changed only copied Dex caught/seen flags and checksums; it is not proof of naturally catching ten species. Initial-transport fixtures were used for the gate and cave checks. The copied party was high level and its Bag already held testing supplies. No owner save was changed. Rock Tunnel's Yellow trainers/encounters and later Kanto remain unfinished; optional details are deferred and PC storage remains ten stacks. No new recording is bundled.
